description: Involved in binding clathrin heavy chain
Necessary for association to the NPC
Sufficient and essential for mediating its nuclear import
Essential for high affinity interaction with RPL23A
Sufficient for RNA-binding, interaction with NXF1-NXT1 heterodimer
Required for interactions with EJC and multimerization
Interaction with HHV-8 ORF57 protein and with ICP27 from HHV-1
Self-association (via N-terminus) to polymerize octameric septin 12-7-6-2/4-2/4-6-7-12 filaments
Interaction with the cytoplasmic tail of GP1BA
Helical; Anchor for type IV membrane protein
